summary: BioNTech SE filed a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026 attaching a press release with updated Phase 3 PRESERVE-003 stage 1 data for gotistobart (BNT316/ONC-392) in previously treated squamous NSCLC. Median overall survival was 18.5 months versus 10.0 months for docetaxel, with a July 17, 2026 data cutoff and 25.4-month median follow-up; 87 patients randomized. There are no transaction terms, no board recommendation, and no advisor. This is a clinical-data disclosure, not a special situation. Watch pivotal-stage confirmation and regulatory filing timelines rather than any deal terms.
